name: Tsun x Bote! ~Ringetsu Ecchi de Kono Ko mo Watashi mo Aishite yo ne♪~
original_name: ツン×ボテ！～臨月エッチでこの子も私も愛してよねっ♪～
source:
The main character, Shoma, is an ordinary student.
One day, a girl who he loves since childhood visits him and asks him to impregnate her to avoid the unwanted marriage.
Shoma, though embarrassed, cannot resist his feelings and accepts it.
She is now pregnant and they still make love!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046894.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
主角翔马是一名普通的学生。
有一天，他从小就喜欢的一个女孩来看望他，要求他让她怀孕，以避免不必要的婚姻。
Shoma虽然感到尴尬，但无法抗拒自己的感受并接受了。
她现在怀孕了，他们仍然做爱！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046894.html]英文DLSite[/url]]
